hook.text: The log is exact, but it stores every request.
The sliding window counter keeps just two numbers per key.

close.text: It assumes last minute's requests were spread evenly.
Cloudflare checked 400 million requests: only 0.003% were wrongly allowed or limited.
close.say: Cloudflare checked four hundred million requests: only zero point zero zero three percent were wrongly allowed or limited.

close.text: Two numbers, no edge spike. A great default.
